notes.title: Stunt Xpress Next Fest June 2024 - BIG demo update!
notes.notes:
Next Fest June 2024 has just started!
As participants, we've prepared a whopper of a demo update for this occasion!

Some of the main points:

new languages! Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese and French!
improved difficulty balance!
added vehicle relative steering! (keyboard & mouse players should like this one!)
lotsa bugfixes!


Here's the full changelog:

General changes:

 New: Last resort ticket mechanic - if you have only 1 ticket left you will never drop to 0 if you every time finish all the tasks during the match
 Vehicles are now little wobbly in the garage and main menu to give them more character.
 Character limit increased to 32 (for longer names width of label will be automatically adjusted).
 Player's vehicle is now incomparably more stable while destroying objects like trees, market stalls, fruit boxes, fences etc.
 Player can now score stunts from arena's initial jump.
 Now rotation speed is slowly decreasing after crash to reduce a "fast spinning vehicle" effect.
 Removed collider from ceiling on the tutorial map.
 New music track

 
Tutorial and onboarding:

 New: Add quick tutorial (on the side menu) to explain in-game progression mechanics
 New: Random small quick tips on the post-match screen (to learn players about indirect mechanics and strategies).
 New: Pause menu now displays control scheme for mouse+keyboard too.

 
Accessibility:

 New: Setting to toggle inverted camera
 New: Experimental user setting - vehicle relative steering
 New: Experimental user setting - keeping camera always behind player's vehicle
 New: Option to switch language inside options menu (currently supported languages: en, pt, pt_BR, fr)

 
UI/UX:

 New: In air drop challenge parcels have now separated timer above them and arrow indicator is pointing on the plane instead.
 New: When match is very close to end there is additional indicator with sfx.
 New: Player can now see item stats in description of unlocked reward.
 New: Redesigned UI for match details screen to improve readability.
 New: Confirmation popup now appears when trying to unlock permanently item.
 New: Now opening new career screen with gamepad (at the first time) will put a "Delivery!" text in the empty "player name" field.
 Improved descriptions for items
 Reversed direction for small circular timer next to arrow indicator.
 Small UI design improvements for garage, shop, options and tournament screens.
 Multiple small improvements for focus navigation and for switching between gamepad and mouse+keyboard.
 Updated graphics for tool slots backgrounds on the tournament screen.
 A "+1 per unlocked reward" label is now appearing only when "next tournament" button is focused.
 Replace 3 variations of scaffold notifications ("Scaffold!", "Left scaffold!", "Right scaffold!") with just one ("Scaffold!").
 Amount of tickets and tokens moved to the left side of the screen (right below player name).
 Fix: Pressing (B)/[ESC] doesn't close options screen.
 Fix: Rotating vehicle on the tournament screen is now fully parallel to the ground (previously it was always little bit skewed).
 Fix: Pressing "WSAD" while editing character name, removes focus from the text field.

 
Gameplay balance:

 Early game is now easier and quicker.
 Difficulty for tasks adjusted to make them easier in early game and harder in late game.
 Now challenge timer is unaffected by slow-mo.
 Hardest matches with mines should now be easier than before (especially on the City map).
 Initial time and bonus time for delivery challenge increased.
 Increased activation range for Stunt Lights "Roundabout" variant.
 Decreased amount of required tow truck tricks in difficult matches.
 Removed Stunt Lights "Stunt" variant from appearing next to roadworks on the city.

 
Bugfixes:

 Scoring is now disallowed during match ending sequence.
 New: Now on startup while loading latest save, the save file will be scanned for any potential issues to fix those if possible to avoid career hard reset .
 Fix: Player doesn't lose Stunt POints by falling outside of the Minigolf map.
 Fix: Unstuck function on the tutorial map.
 Fix: Vehicle still moves after teleportation to another location in the middle of tutorial.
 Fix: Helmets appear as a match reward but they never should.
 Fix: Navigating with LStick changes focus multiple times with single motion.
 Fix: Arrow indicator sometimes points to random empty space during tutorial.
 Fix: Weird glitch effect caused by fast moving camera when player is teleported to the second tutorial location
 Fix: Sometimes vehicle was completely losing suspension after interacting with air vents.
 Fix: Some specific tutorial sequences could potentially break tutorial.
 Fix: Sometimes when loading older saves vehicle at start was white without any texture.
 Fix: Crashes related to "Arena" map generation.
 Fix: Potential crash when closing post-match screen.


---

We're looking forward to hearing your feedback in Steam discussions or at our official Discord server!
